conventions: Recommended order: list_sessions/create_session/switch_session/get_session_info first, then drawing and export tools.
All mutating tools persist the active scene file immediately.
Most mutating tools return: ok, object_id when applicable, object_count, selected_object_ids, and scene_path.
Named sessions are the primary multi-board workflow. Raw scene-file tools and --scene mode are compatibility workflows.
If this server is still attached to a raw scene file, use create_session_from_scene to migrate that board into a named session before doing multi-board/session-oriented work.
SceneColor uses {"r":255,"g":200,"b":0,"a":255}. Use all four fields for compatibility.
Object ids come from get_scene or get_selected_objects.
Triangles can be created with add_triangle(rect=...) for quick isosceles shapes or add_triangle(points=[...]) for arbitrary three-vertex shapes.
add_polygon(points=[...]) also accepts exactly three points if you want to model triangles as generic polygons.

returns: object_id: id of the new circle.
selected_object_ids: set to the new object.

request_fields.description: Optional stroke override. Defaults to the server's standard stroke.
request_fields.name: stroke

returns: object_id: id of the new line.
selected_object_ids: set to the new object.

add_polygon.description: Add a polygon from an ordered list of points. Supplying exactly three points creates a free-form triangle without using the triangle convenience wrapper.

request_fields.description: Array of at least three CanvasPoint values in drawing order.
request_fields.name: points

returns: object_id: id of the new polygon.
selected_object_ids: set to the new object.
object_id: id of the new rectangle.
selected_object_ids: set to the new object.

add_stroke.description: Add a freehand stroke object from an ordered list of points.

request_fields.description: Array of at least two CanvasPoint values in drawing order.
request_fields.name: points

returns: object_id: id of the new stroke.
selected_object_ids: set to the new object.
object_id: id of the new text object.
selected_object_ids: set to the new object.

add_triangle.description: Add a triangle using either a quick bounding rectangle or three explicit points. This is a convenience API over a 3-point shape.

request_fields.description: Optional bounding rectangle as SceneRect. Use this for quick drag-style isosceles triangle creation.
request_fields.name: rect

request_fields.description: Optional array of exactly three CanvasPoint values. Use this for arbitrary or rotated triangles.
request_fields.name: points

returns: object_id: id of the new triangle.
selected_object_ids: set to the new object.

assign_object_to_canvas.description: Assign an existing object to a canvas frame.
returns: object_id / object_canvas_id: updated membership for the object.
canvases / memberships: updated universe metadata lists.

clear_object_canvas_assignment.description: Remove any canvas membership from an existing object.

request_fields.description: Existing object id with a current canvas assignment.
request_fields.name: object_id

returns: object_id: object whose membership was cleared.
canvases / memberships: updated universe metadata lists.

clear_scene.description: Remove every object from the active scene.
returns: session_id: active named session for this server instance, if any.

create_canvas.description: Create a named canvas frame in the active universe and make it active.
returns: canvas_id: id of the new canvas.
active_canvas_id / selected_canvas_ids: updated canvas focus state.
canvases / memberships: updated universe metadata lists.

create_session.description: Create a named session backed by a scene JSON file and a manifest JSON file.

request_fields.description: New session id. ASCII letters, digits, '-', '_' and '.' are allowed.
request_fields.name: session_id

request_fields.description: If true, switch this MCP server instance to the new session immediately.
request_fields.name: make_active

returns: active_session_id: current named session after the call.
session: metadata for the created session.

create_session_from_scene.description: Create a named session from the currently active raw scene file and attach this MCP server to it. Use this to migrate orphan file-based boards into the named-session workflow.

request_fields.description: New session id. ASCII letters, digits, '-', '_' and '.' are allowed.
request_fields.name: session_id

returns: previous_scene_path: raw scene path that was migrated.
active_session_id: current named session after the call.
session: metadata for the created and attached session.

delete_object.description: Delete a single object by id.

duplicate_object.description: Duplicate an existing object by id with an optional offset.

request_fields.description: Optional x offset in pixels. Defaults to 24.
request_fields.name: dx

request_fields.description: Optional y offset in pixels. Defaults to 24.
request_fields.name: dy

export_scene_json.description: Return the full active scene as a pretty-printed JSON string that can be written directly to another file.
returns: session_id: active named session for this server instance, if any.

fill_object.description: Set or replace the fill color of an existing object by id.

get_api_docs.description: Return full documentation for every Boardmesh MCP command in one call.

get_scene.description: Return the full active scene as structured JSON.

get_selected_objects.description: Return the current selection and full payloads for the selected objects.
returns: objects: array of the selected object payloads.
object_count: total object count in the scene.
session_id: active named session for this server instance, if any.

get_selection_context.description: Return semantic context for the current selection, including canvas membership, connected objects, and nearby objects.
returns: session_id: active named session for this server instance, if any.
context: structured SelectionContext for the active selection.

get_session_info.description: Return metadata for the currently active named session.
returns: runtime_api_version: this MCP binary's runtime API version.
attached_windows: live windows recorded by the GUI heartbeat.
attached_servers: live MCP servers recorded by the server heartbeat.

get_tool_help.description: Return example payloads and parameter notes for one tool or for all tools.

request_fields.description: Optional tool name filter. Omit it to get examples for every tool.
request_fields.name: tool_name

returns: tools: example payloads grouped by tool.

get_universe.description: Return the full active universe document, including canvases, memberships, viewport state, and the embedded scene.
returns: session_id: active named session for this server instance, if any.

list_sessions.description: List the named board sessions known under the configured sessions directory.
returns: active_session_id: current named session for this MCP server instance, if any.
sessions_dir: directory used to store named session scene and manifest files.

load_scene_json.description: Load a full scene JSON string into the active scene file or another target path.

request_fields.description: Optional destination file. If omitted, the active scene file is replaced.
request_fields.name: path

request_fields.description: If true, switch the MCP server to the destination file after writing.
request_fields.name: make_active

returns: target_path: file written by the call.
session_id: active named session for this server instance, if any.
scene_path: active scene after the call.
object_count and selected_object_ids from the loaded scene.

move_object_backward.description: Move an object one step backward in the draw order.

move_object_forward.description: Move an object one step forward in the draw order.

move_object_to_back.description: Move an object to the back of the draw order.

move_object_to_front.description: Move an object to the front of the draw order.

render_scene_png.description: Render the whole active scene to a PNG file and return the output path plus crop metadata.

request_fields.description: Optional destination PNG path. If omitted, the server writes to a temporary file.
request_fields.name: path

request_fields.description: Optional padding in pixels to expand the crop bounds around the scene content.
request_fields.name: padding

returns: bounds: crop rectangle in scene coordinates.

render_selected_png.description: Render only the currently selected objects to a cropped PNG file.

request_fields.description: Optional destination PNG path. If omitted, the server writes to a temporary file.
request_fields.name: path

request_fields.description: Optional padding in pixels to expand the crop bounds around the selected objects.
request_fields.name: padding

returns: bounds: crop rectangle in scene coordinates.
object_count: number of selected objects rendered.

save_scene_as.description: Write the current active scene to another file path.

request_fields.description: Destination path for the saved scene JSON file.
request_fields.name: path

request_fields.description: If true, switch the MCP server to use the new file as the active scene.
request_fields.name: make_active

returns: target_path: file written by the call.
session_id: active named session for this server instance, if any.
scene_path: active scene after the call.
object_count and selected_object_ids from the written scene.

select_canvases.description: Replace the current canvas selection with the provided canvas ids.
returns: canvases / memberships: updated universe metadata lists.

select_objects.description: Replace the current selection with the provided object ids.

set_active_canvas.description: Set or clear the active canvas.

request_fields.description: Existing canvas id, or null to clear.
request_fields.name: canvas_id

returns: canvases / memberships: updated universe metadata lists.

set_object_locked.description: Lock or unlock an object against movement.

request_fields.description: Whether the object should be locked.
request_fields.name: locked

set_object_visibility.description: Hide or show an object by id.

request_fields.description: Whether the object should remain visible.
request_fields.name: visible

returns: object_count: scene object count remains unchanged.

switch_scene.description: Change which scene file the MCP server is currently reading and writing.

request_fields.description: Path to the scene JSON file to activate.
request_fields.name: path

request_fields.description: If true, create a default empty scene file when the path does not exist.
request_fields.name: create_if_missing

returns: session_id: active named session for this server instance, if any.
scene_path: active scene after the call.
object_count and selected_object_ids from the loaded scene.

switch_session.description: Switch this MCP server instance to a named session.

request_fields.description: If true, create the session scene and manifest when they do not exist.
request_fields.name: create_if_missing

returns: active_session_id: current named session after the call.
session: metadata for the activated session.
